episodes.title: Your Trip Has Arrived
episodes.summary: Kang Yeo-reum, a travel reporter from a failed girl group, is struggling to make ends meet. Just as her only remaining travel segment is being canceled, a strange request arrives from America. A viewer from another country, who has enjoyed Yeo-reum's travel segment for five years, asks her to travel to the city of Buyeo on her behalf. "Traveling for me?" Yeo-reum's mind is starting to spin!

episodes.title: Departure
episodes.summary: After losing her job and hitting rock bottom, Yeo-reum suddenly and without a plan sets off for Buyeo, where she's asked to travel in her place. In an unfamiliar place, among unfamiliar people, she encounters a warm hand for the first time, and the true meaning of "travel." And the clues that lead her on her journey: a prayer tree bracelet sent by her client and a 400-year-old sycamore tree she encountered in Buyeo. Why did she spend her summer here?

episodes.title: Can Trees Travel?
episodes.summary: Yeo-reum witnesses a woman in Buyeo who resembles her client, Kate. She is Ji-sook, a hanbok master who has been making hanbok in Buyeo for a long time. Amidst the seemingly incoherent situation, Yeo-reum struggles to understand Ji-sook. Meanwhile, Yeon-seok, who joined Ogu Entertainment after the show's cancellation, proposes to Sang-sik that they start a travel agency specializing in surrogate travel.

episodes.title: Make a Wish, Genie
episodes.summary: The second request follows shortly after. It's a trip to Pohang with a golden retriever. Yeo-reum embarks on a luxurious journey with a dog named "Genie" on behalf of a client who has kept a low profile. It's a puzzling journey with Genie, who reacts quite differently than other dogs. Meanwhile, Yeo-reum comes across a scandalous article about Si-wan and Eun-chae, her former first loves and friends, now top stars. She ends up losing Genie!

episodes.title: Don't Forget Me…
episodes.summary: During a proxy trip to Pohang, Yeo-reum overhears the story of actor Lee Jung-woo, who once filmed there and befriended the people there. Yeo-reum begins to suspect that he, who disappeared without a trace five years ago, may be Genie's true owner. Meanwhile, after hearing from a veterinarian that Genie's health is deteriorating, Yeo-reum breaks her security agreement and contacts her client, only to receive a heartless message. She begins to realize that this trip is more than just a proxy trip.

episodes.title: The Two-Faced Traveler
episodes.summary: This trip takes her to Hakodate, Hokkaido, Japan. Yeo-reum embarks on her first-ever overseas trip. The excitement is fleeting, and as she busily follows the locations her clients have left behind, she repeatedly encounters a woman named Haruko at the same location. Haruko, who visits this place every year only on her birthday, seems to have something off about her. Through these seemingly coincidental encounters, Yeo-reum witnesses a shocking sight in Haruko...

episodes.title: Until Your Heart Stops
episodes.summary: The person who requested the Hakodate trip was Yeong-hoon, a cardiac surgeon and junior of Sang-sik. Unable to attend due to an important surgery, he asked Yeo-reum to travel on his behalf, along with a detailed itinerary. Meanwhile, as Haruko's appearances reappear throughout the videos Yeo-reum sent, Yeon-seok begins to suspect that their travel schedules are the same, and Yeo-reum grows increasingly confused. What hidden connection exists between Yeong-hoon and Haruko?

episodes.title: The Color of Success
episodes.summary: Yeo-reum and Sang-sik were summoned by the chairwoman of a leading conglomerate. She was the sponsor of the "Day Trip" program that Yeo-reum was hosting. The chairwoman's request is simple: to ascend the Seongjeon Am Temple in Jinju, a place where you can achieve enlightenment if you climb ten times. Yeo-reum accepted Chairwoman Seong's offer, but in exchange for the generous fee, she stipulated the revival of "Day Trip." However, Yeo-reum began to harbor doubts. Why, of all people, had she asked her this favor? What other story lay hidden in this journey?

episodes.title: Me and You, If...
episodes.summary: The revival of "One Day Trip," promised in exchange for her agency travel, falls through with the sudden death of Chairman Sung. Meanwhile, Chairman Sung's daughter, the director responsible for the abolition of Yeo-reum's program, visits Ogu Entertainment. Suspicious of Yeo-reum's connection with Chairman Sung after her mother's death, she confronts him, presenting him with a confidentiality agreement between them. Ultimately, the director hands Yeo-reum an old key and asks her to take her on a trip.

episodes.title: Finding the Lighthouse
episodes.summary: As the video of the surrogate travel agency went viral, PD Song, who worked with Yeo-reum on "One Day Trip," approached her and proposed a new travel program for Yeo-reum to host alone. Just as Yeo-reum and the Ogu Entertainment staff were busy preparing the program, rumors of Si-wan and Eun-chae's breakup surfaced, with malicious scandalous articles claiming Yeo-reum was the reason. The controversy caused the broadcasting station to abruptly shelve the new program, and Yeo-reum finds herself at a crossroads once again...
